name: Mystic 6
description:
About This Game

A tactical card RPG where each card strikes with a unique placeable grid pattern to outsmart your enemies. Along your journey, weapons, potions, skills, runes, and much more will shape every run.

Features

  • Unlock Your Heroes — 6 characters, 6 playstyles. Start with one, unlock the rest as you go.

  • Tactical Grid — Each card carries a unique attack pattern that you freely rotate and reposition across the 5×5 battlefield, turning every move into a tactical decision.

  • Loot & Gear — Discover weapons, armor, and equipment throughout your journey. Each piece uniquely modifies your stats and playstyle, so choose wisely — every run is a new build.

  • Skills & Progression — Defeat enemies to earn skill points and spend them freely across a deep upgrade system. Boost your attack, reinforce your defense, expand your backpack, or increase your critical hit chances. The choice is yours.

  • Runes & Rituals — Earn runes from fallen bosses and portal rifts, then socket them into your powers at the lab to reshape your build

  • World Map — Forge your own journey across a branching map. Choose your next destination freely — whether that's battling Elites, challenging fearsome Bosses, or destroying portals. Your path, your rules.

  • Debuffs & Interactions — Each attack type can inflict unique debuffs on your enemies. Combine them strategically as different debuffs interact with different attack types, unleashing increased damage.

  • Attack Order — Strategy doesn't end with placement. When unleashing multiple attack types in a single turn, the order you cast them matters — chain your spells wisely to maximize devastation.

  • Biomes — Every battle takes place across a variety of distinct biomes, each one altering the battlefield in unique ways and forcing you to adapt your strategy.
